comparison.objective: Orient two loose eggs small-end down and place them into carton cups; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Fragile ovoid reorientation, gentle grasping and precise cup placement versus rigid tool insertion, collar rotation, locking and cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Eggs released in the correct cups and orientation without drop or damage versus two safe repeatable impacts. Candidate dynamic limits remain partly undeclared.
comparison.reason: Fragile-object orientation and placement are unrelated to adjustable shock-absorber commissioning.
